name: 17019 · Dillsburg, PA
findings: ZIP 17019 (Dillsburg) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17019 (Dillsburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
